zh.title: 中華航空桃園飛阿姆斯特丹長程線航班首度添加40%永續燃油
zh.summary: 華航桃園至阿姆斯特丹航班首度添加40%永續燃油，預計減碳93.2公噸。
body: 中華航空於9月13日執行由桃園飛往阿姆斯特丹的長程線航班，首度在飛航中添加40%的永續航空燃油（SAF）。這是華航今年第5度響應天合聯盟（SkyTeam）發起的「航空飛行挑戰」（The Aviation Challenge），並將永續燃油示範航班擴大至長程航線，展現推進淨零碳排與永續發展的具體行動。
華航總經理陳漢銘表示，這是華航自2022年以來第8次添加永續航空燃油，同時也是首次在長程航線使用高達40%的比例。本次航班共使用約36.3公噸永續燃油，預計可減少約93.2公噸二氧化碳排放量，減碳效果相當於40輛小客車的一年碳排放量，或是四分之一座大安森林公園的一年碳吸附量。
除了提升永續燃油添加比例外，該示範航班亦推行多項機上減碳與環保措施。華航再次與中國信託銀行合作，並全面更換輕量化餐盤與餐具，將重量降低30%以減輕機身載重並減少燃油消耗。此外，機上菜單與酒單採用大豆油墨印刷，並提供米其林綠星蔬食餐廳「小小樹食」的餐點，鼓勵旅客選擇低碳飲食及使用線上登機證。
針對永續燃油的成本效益，陳漢銘說明，過去永續燃油的價格約為一般航空燃油的2.5倍至3倍。對於未來是否將相關成本反映於機票價格，華航將持續關注市場趨勢，並借鏡新加坡航空等同業在永續領域的發展經驗，待市場與旅客認同度更高時，再行評估是否跟進調整票價結構。

en.title: China Airlines Operates First Long-Haul Flight Using 40% Sustainable Aviation Fuel Blend
en.summary: China Airlines used a 40 percent sustainable aviation fuel blend on its flight from Taoyuan to Amsterdam.
body: Taiwanese carrier China Airlines operated a long-haul demonstration flight from Taoyuan to Amsterdam on September 13 using a 40 percent blend of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). This marked the airline's first time utilizing a 40 percent SAF blend on a long-haul flight, as well as its fifth time participating in SkyTeam's annual sustainability initiative, The Aviation Challenge, which focused on the theme of collective momentum across enterprise partners and supply chains.

China Airlines President Chen Han-ming stated during a media briefing that the milestone represents the airline's eighth time utilizing sustainable aviation fuel since 2022. The flight from Taoyuan consumed approximately 36.3 tonnes of SAF, which is estimated to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by around 93.2 metric tons, an impact equivalent to the annual carbon absorption of a quarter of Daan Forest Park or the emissions of 40 passenger cars.

Alongside the higher SAF blend, China Airlines introduced several operational and inflight weight-reduction measures for the demonstration flight in partnership with card issuer CTBC Bank. The carrier completely replaced standard service tableware with lightweight alternatives, achieving a 30 percent weight reduction designed to directly lower aircraft load and fuel consumption. In addition, menus and wine lists were printed using eco-friendly soybean ink, plant-based meals from Michelin Green Star restaurant Little Tree Food were provided, and passengers were encouraged to adopt digital boarding passes.

Addressing the economic considerations of sustainable fuel adoption, Chen explained that SAF historically costs between 2.5 and 3 times more than conventional jet fuel. Regarding whether these expenses could eventually influence passenger airfares, Chen noted that China Airlines is observing market maturity and practices at industry peers such as Singapore Airlines, adding that the carrier would evaluate potential fare adjustments only after reaching comparable maturity and securing broader market and passenger support.

zh.title: 波羅的海航空於美國聲請第11章破產保護 獲4.05億美元融資承諾
zh.summary: 波羅的海航空於美國聲請破產重組；已獲3.5億歐元融資；航班維持正常營運
body: 拉脫維亞國家航空「波羅的海航空」（airBaltic）及其部分子公司於2026年9月14日，主動向美國紐約南區破產法院聲請第11章破產保護。這項由法院監督的債務重組程序，旨在幫助該航空公司在維持正常航班營運的同時削減債務。該公司預計將於2027年6月左右完成第11章破產重組程序。

為了在重組期間提供必要的流動資金，波羅的海航空已獲得3.5億歐元（約合4.05億美元）的占有債務人融資（DIP融資）承諾，該融資計畫仍需取得法院批准。該筆融資由Strategic Value Partners安排，並由包括巴克萊銀行（Barclays）、Hayfin Capital Management、摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）、Oaktree Capital Management及Strategic Value Partners在內的投資團隊提供資金。
波羅的海航空強調，在法院監督的重組過程中，定期航班、機票銷售、座位預訂及客戶服務均將維持正常運作。旅客現有的機票、折抵券與點數依然完全有效。該航空公司總裁兼執行長埃爾諾·希爾登（Erno Hildén）表示，營運團隊將專注於維持營運穩定，確保旅客的行程體驗不受破產重組程序影響。
本次財務重組亦伴隨機隊規模調整。波羅的海航空目前營運由54架空中巴士A220-300組成的單一機隊。根據2026年8月公布的新商業計畫，該航空公司打算在2026年底前將機隊規模縮減至36架，隨後再於2031年前逐步恢復至約40架。
該航空公司的財務困境因美伊戰爭爆發後燃油價格大幅上漲而進一步加劇，主因是波羅的海航空未對燃油需求進行避險。這項影響與高額債務及飛機租賃成本等既有壓力重疊。目前拉脫維亞政府持有波羅的海航空88.37%的控股股權，而漢莎航空集團（Lufthansa Group）則持有2025年取得的10%少數股權。

en.title: airBaltic Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Protection in United States
en.summary: airBaltic files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States while continuing flight operations.
body: Latvia's flag carrier airBaltic and certain subsidiaries voluntarily filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York on September 14, 2026. The court-supervised restructuring process is designed to assist the airline in reducing its debt load while maintaining ongoing flight operations. The carrier expects to complete the Chapter 11 proceedings around June 2027.

To provide essential liquidity during the reorganization, airBaltic has secured commitments for €350 million ($405 million) in debtor-in-possession financing, subject to court approval. The financing facility was arranged by Strategic Value Partners and funded by an investor group including Barclays, Hayfin Capital Management, Morgan Stanley, Oaktree Capital Management, and Strategic Value Partners. The facility carries an interest rate of SOFR plus 8%, equivalent to approximately 12% at current rates.

airBaltic confirmed that scheduled flights, ticket sales, seat reservations, and customer service operations will continue normally throughout the court-supervised restructuring. Existing passenger tickets, vouchers, and credits remain fully valid. President and Chief Executive Officer Erno Hildén stated that the airline's primary focus remains on maintaining operational stability, ensuring that travel experiences for passengers remain unaffected.

The financial restructuring coincides with an operational downsizing of the airline's fleet. airBaltic currently operates an all-Airbus A220-300 fleet of 54 aircraft. Under a revised business plan announced in August 2026, the carrier intends to reduce its fleet to 36 aircraft by the end of 2026, before gradually rebuilding the fleet size to approximately 40 aircraft by 2031.

The carrier's financial difficulties were exacerbated by sharp increases in jet fuel costs following the outbreak of the US-Iran war, as airBaltic had not hedged its fuel requirements. These challenges compounded existing pressures from high debt and leasing obligations. The Latvian government retains controlling ownership of airBaltic with an 88.37% stake, while Lufthansa Group holds a 10% minority stake acquired in 2025.

zh.title: 西南航空規劃於2031年前退役737-700機隊
zh.summary: 西南航空規劃於2031年以前退役旗下的737-700型機隊
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，西南航空（Southwest Airlines）規劃在 2031 年以前，將奠定該航空公司現今規模的機型全數退役。報導指出，西南航空旗下營運的 737-700 機隊規模相當龐大，該機型在該航空公司的發展歷程中扮演了重要角色。
公開訊息顯示，這項機隊調整計畫預計於 2031 年完成退役時程。西南航空長期以來營運龐大的 737-700 機隊，相關退役規劃將影響該航空公司的機隊結構與後續營運佈局。
目前發布的資訊主要聚焦於該機型預計於 2031 年退役的總體時程。關於具體的退役階段規劃、替代機型引進進度以及詳細的機隊轉換時程，仍有待航空公司官方與相關單位進一步發布與說明。

zh.title: 美國航空旅客頭等艙暴走 遭同機乘客用膠帶固定制伏
zh.summary: 美國航空班機發生頭等艙旅客施暴，遭同機乘客以膠帶固定在座位上。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，一名67歲的男性旅客在美國航空從達拉斯飛往紐瓦克的航班上，於頭等艙內發起種族歧視與恐同言論，並對其他旅客及空服員進行言語與肢體攻擊。在此期間，三名同機乘客合力使用束帶與膠帶將其綁在座位上，這名旅客在被制伏過程中還咬了其中一名乘客。
本站歷史資料庫顯示，該起事件發生於2026年9月3日，涉事航班為美國航空618號班機，當時由波音737-800執飛，從達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場（DFW）飛往紐瓦克自由國際機場（EWR）。受此事件影響，航班隨後轉降至巴爾的摩/華盛頓瑟古德·馬歇爾國際機場（BWI），由當地警方登機將該名滋事旅客逮捕，隨後航班才重新起飛前往紐瓦克。

en.title: American Airlines Passenger Bound to Seat With Duct Tape After In-Flight Rampage
en.summary: American Airlines passengers restrained a violent traveler with duct tape on a flight from Dallas to Newark.
body: According to Simple Flying, three passengers on an American Airlines flight from Dallas to Newark restrained a 67-year-old traveler after he turned violent during a racist and homophobic tirade in the Domestic First Class cabin. The passenger assaulted two travelers and shouted slurs at a flight attendant before being bound to his seat with zip ties and duct tape. During the struggle, the man bit one of the passengers attempting to hold him down.

Verified records show the incident occurred on September 3, 2026, on American Airlines Flight 618, a Boeing 737-800 flying from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) to Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR). Due to the disturbance, the flight diverted to Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), where police arrested the passenger before the flight continued to Newark.

zh.title: BAC Helicopters動用空中巴士H130直升機支援莫三比克水患救災
zh.summary: BAC Helicopters以H130直升機於莫三比克水患期間運送世界糧食計劃署物資
body: 在2026年莫三比克遭受洪水致使部分區域陷入孤立期間，空中巴士（Airbus）客戶BAC Helicopters調派一架H130直升機投入空運物資與救災支援任務，協助運送世界糧食計劃署（World Food Program）的關鍵救援物資。
根據空中巴士於2026年9月14日公布的訊息，莫三比克因強烈水患導致地面交通中斷，相關地區運補作業受阻。BAC Helicopters運用H130直升機的空中運輸能力，成功將救援物資送達受洪水影響的災區。
本次空中運補行動旨在支援世界糧食計劃署在當地的緊急人道救援工作，確保受洪水困住的災民能獲得必要之糧食與物資供應。

en.title: BAC Helicopters Uses Airbus H130 to Deliver Relief Supplies in Mozambique Floods
en.summary: BAC Helicopters deployed an Airbus H130 to deliver World Food Program relief supplies during Mozambique floods.
body: During the 2026 floods that isolated parts of Mozambique, aviation operator BAC Helicopters deployed an Airbus H130 helicopter to perform aerial transport missions and deliver essential World Food Program supplies to flood-affected communities.

According to information published by manufacturer Airbus on September 14, 2026, severe flooding across Mozambique disrupted local ground transport and cut off remote areas. BAC Helicopters utilized the Airbus H130 to maintain aerial delivery operations under these challenging conditions.

The flights provided critical logistical support for the World Food Program, ensuring that emergency relief reached isolated populations after floodwaters restricted conventional access across the affected regions.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空調整冬季班表 暫停兩目的地空中巴士A380航班
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空重塑長程冬季班表；暫停兩目的地空中巴士A380航班
body: 總部位於杜拜的阿聯酋航空（Emirates）針對長程航線網路調整，重塑了冬季班表安排。在這項最新班表調整中，該公司已暫停向兩個主要目的地營運空中巴士A380客機航班。
根據過往資料，阿聯酋航空工程部門曾開展數十億美元的大規模改裝計畫，對旗下共219架空中巴士A380與波音777客機進行全面翻修作業。
此外，阿聯酋航空先前亦透過購入已退役的空中巴士A380客機並進行拆解，以取得組件維持其龐大A380機隊之營運需求。

en.title: Emirates Reshapes Winter Schedules and Suspends Airbus A380 Flights to 2 Major Destinations
en.summary: Emirates reshapes its winter schedule; suspends Airbus A380 service on two major long-haul routes.
body: Dubai-based carrier Emirates has officially reshaped its winter flight schedules across key long-haul routes. As part of the seasonal network adjustments, the airline has suspended its Airbus A380 service to two major destinations.

According to verified historical records, Emirates Engineering previously initiated a multi-billion-dollar retrofit program designed to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft within the carrier's widebody fleet.

In addition, Emirates has purchased retired Airbus A380 aircraft specifically to take them apart rather than return them to flight service, harvesting valuable component parts to maintain its operational fleet.

zh.title: 日本航空與Donecle展開全自動無人機飛機檢查合作
zh.summary: 日本航空與Donecle合作於機棚導入全自動無人機，執行飛機外觀檢查項目。
body: 日本航空（JAL）與法國無人機製造商 Donecle 於2026年9月11日宣布展開聯合驗證計畫，在日本航空的機棚內引進全自動無人機執行飛機外觀檢查。該項合作旨在將以往由維修機師手動進行、費時且高體力消耗的機身檢驗作業實現自動化處理。
根據 AeroTime 報導，這項合作項目採用 Donecle 研發的 Iris GVI 無人機，在日航機棚內部拍攝飛機外觀的高解析度影像。傳統目視檢查需要維修人員長時間在高處以多種角度檢視大型機身，而無人機系統能提供統一標準的影像擷取，並減少人員在高處作業的風險。
Donecle Iris GVI 無人機的長與寬均為 855 公釐，高度為 245 公釐，包含電池在內的總重量為 3,700 公克。該機型具備全自動飛行模式，並配備內建障礙物偵測技術，能在不接觸機身的情況下保持安全距離運作。此外，該系統結合影像分析技術，能精確地繪製並測量機身外表面的缺陷。
Donecle 專為商用客機至廣體客機等各式機種設計自動化無人機解決方案，該無人機設備已被列入空中巴士（Airbus）與波音（Boeing）的官方飛機維修手冊中。日本航空自2026年6月底即開始對傳統目視檢查與無人機拍攝影像進行比對測試，為此次聯合驗證奠定基礎。
未來，日本航空與 Donecle 規劃將無人機的應用範圍由機棚示範擴大至更多情境。雙方計畫在日本國土交通省（MLIT）的合作下，推動非計畫性雷擊快速檢查與機身漆面狀況定期監測，以縮短因雷擊檢查導致的航班延誤並提升飛機品質。

en.title: Japan Airlines and Donecle Launch Autonomous Drone Aircraft Inspection Project
en.summary: Japan Airlines and Donecle launched autonomous drone exterior aircraft inspections in Japan on September 11.
body: Japan Airlines (JAL) and French drone manufacturer Donecle announced a joint verification project on September 11, 2026, deploying fully autonomous drones inside airline hangars to carry out exterior aircraft inspections in Japan. The initiative aims to automate visually intensive and physically demanding aircraft body inspections traditionally performed manually by mechanics.

Under the project, Donecle’s Iris GVI drone operates inside JAL’s maintenance hangars to capture high-resolution imagery of aircraft surfaces. The system replaces traditional manual visual checks that require mechanics to examine massive airframes from multiple angles and elevated positions over extended periods. Donecle's automated drone solutions are designed for aircraft ranging from business jets to widebody airliners.

The Iris GVI drone measures 855 millimeters in length and width, 245 millimeters in height, and weighs 3,700 grams including its battery. It operates in fully autonomous flight mode around the airframe without physical contact, utilizing built-in obstacle detection technology to ensure safety clearance. The unit includes image analysis software capable of precisely mapping and measuring surface defects identified on the airframe.

Donecle's drone inspection solutions have received industry validation, being listed in official aircraft maintenance manuals published by both Airbus and Boeing. JAL laid the groundwork for the project by comparing drone-captured imagery with conventional visual inspections starting at the end of June 2026. Time saved through autonomous drone checks is expected to be redirected toward predictive maintenance workflows.

Looking beyond initial hangar demonstration tests, JAL and Donecle plan to expand the technology's operational scope. Future planned applications include accelerating unscheduled lightning strike inspections to mitigate flight delays and conducting regular monitoring of aircraft paint conditions, both developed in collaboration with Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT).
